papers.title: Dimensional assessment of uniformly periodic porosity primitive TPMS lattices using additive manufacturing laser powder bed fusion technique
papers.first_author_affiliation: Additive Design and Manufacturing Systems Laboratory, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada

corresponding_authors.name: Ali Mulhi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Additive Design and Manufacturing Systems Laboratory, University of Alberta, Edmonton, AB, Canada

papers.venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造TPMS点阵的结构尺寸精度，与用户方向中的多孔结构与应力屏蔽相关，但未涉及生物医学应用或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no stress shielding or stiffness matching, and no mechanical or fatigue testing reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估LPBF制造均匀周期孔隙TPMS点阵的尺寸精度。
summary_zh.method: 通过实验测量与设计模型对比，分析点阵单元的尺寸偏差。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了工艺参数对孔隙单元尺寸精度的影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量与CAD模型对比验证尺寸精度。

summary_en.motivation: To assess the dimensional accuracy of uniformly periodic porous TPMS lattices fabricated by LPBF.
summary_en.method: Experimental characterization of as-built dimensions compared to the computer-aided design (CAD) model.
summary_en.result: Identified deviations and relationships between porosity unit cell size and manufacturing accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement and comparison with nominal design.

papers.title: Effect of build orientation on dynamic compressive behaviour of Ti-6Al-4V alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Beijing Institute of Technology Chongqing Innovation Center, Chongqing 401120, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Jing Xie
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Explosion Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, PR China

corresponding_authors.name: Pengwan Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Explosion Science and Technology, Beijing Institute of Technology, Beijing 100081, PR China

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V的构建取向对动态压缩性能的影响，但未涉及生物医用植入物所需的应力遮挡、多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究构建取向对SLM Ti-6Al-4V动态压缩行为的影响
summary_zh.method: 不同取向SLM成形后进行动态压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 构建取向显著影响动态压缩强度与应变率敏感性
summary_zh.validation: 动态压缩力学测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of build orientation on the dynamic compressive behavior of Ti-6Al-4V fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Samples were manufactured with different orientations relative to the build platform and subjected to dynamic compression tests.
summary_en.result: Build orientation significantly influences dynamic strength and strain-rate sensitivity, with vertically oriented samples showing higher flow stress.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through dynamic compression testing at various strain rates using a split Hopkinson pressure bar.
